description: Suez and Panama canal transits is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). This dataset shows the timeseries data of total monthly transits and carrying capacity (DWT and DT million) of vessels in the Suez and Panama canals, Bosphorus Strait and the Gulf of Aden from 2016 to date. Coverage: not tied to one country in the listing. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Its tags are logistics, trade, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
